findings.description: F-2.3 detail endpoint now aggregates comments list + up/down counts. Spec §2.2 acceptance ('返回完整 content + 评论数 + 点赞数') and DEV-PLAN WI-5 ('join 拉评论列表 + 点赞/点踩 count') both satisfied. PostDetailOut schema (posts.py:71-74) adds comments: list[CommentOut], up_count: int, down_count: int with defaults [] / 0. _to_detail (posts.py:103-131) sorts comments by created_at ascending and calls _counts(db, post.id) for the counts. selectinload(Post.comments) on the detail path prevents N+1. 3 new tests assert all three fields; all green.

Bonus GET /api/posts/{post_id}/reactions endpoint exists (reactions.py:121) but is not in Spec §2.2. Low risk: useful helper, frontend can call it, no spec violation of contract (only additions, not contradictions). With WI-5 in place the frontend can derive counts from the detail endpoint, so this helper is now redundant but harmless. Recommend documenting in Spec when frontend WI-5 is built, or removing it.
